# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple TFM and WinUI fixes**

## Highlights

This unreleased 3.119.x line backports Apple 26.0 TFM support and fixes a missing WinUI projection DLL.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 backport** — Backports the 26.0 library and unversioned app target framework monikers to the 3.119.x servicing line. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI projection DLL restored** — Fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found by .NET 9 consumers. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
